It is here for three things the Lake Louise fixture cannot show, because zero and UTC-6 hide all of them: snow_depth arrives in METRES (2.69) and must be published as centimetres, snowfall_cm_24h must be a real sum over 24 hourly values, and the timezone is Pacific/Auckland on the far side of the date line — local 2026-09-16, a calendar day ahead of the instant Lake Louise was read at.
